blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – The Metro Cebu Collegiate Basketball League (MCCBL) Season 2 brings its games to Cebu City for the first time, with unbeaten Cordova Public College (CPC) Eels seeking to extend their winning streak against last year’s finalists, the Talisay City College (TCC) Talisalites, in a marquee collegiate matchup on Tuesday, November 10, at the Cebu City Sports Institute in Barangay Sawang Calero. The two-day games, scheduled for Tuesday and Wednesday, will bring the league closer to Cebu City basketball fans, featuring top collegiate and high school teams in what promises to be an action-packed resumption of the tournament.
